layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin bright-red rectangular border inset from the edges (approx. x 6%-94%, y 8%-96%). Title centered at the top in bold red. A yellow circular slide-number badge ('20') sits in the top-right corner inside the border. Upper-left: a red-outlined white box containing the ReLU definition and its piecewise formula. Upper-middle/right: the label 'F(x) = ReLU' above a blue-framed ReLU plot; a yellow ellipse highlights the flat (saturated) segment of the curve on the negative x-axis, and a red arrow points from the 'Saturation Problem' callout box (middle-left) into that ellipse. Three dashed red arrows fan out from the bottom of the top ReLU plot down to three blue-framed plots arranged in a row across the bottom third: Parametric ReLU (left), ELU (center, with a small legend), SoftPlus (right). Each bottom plot has an italic color-coded caption centered directly beneath it. A solid black horizontal bar (video-player overlay) runs along the very bottom edge of the frame.
